task: 1. Use OCR to extract all car records from car_inventory.pdf. 2. Identify all cars with 'Black' color and mileage less than 40000. 3. Save these cars into an Excel file named black_cars.xlsx, making sure to include all details for each selected car (at least Car ID, Miles, Color, Driver). 4. Add a note in the Excel first sheet cell (A1) stating: 'Cars selected on 2020-05-01: Black, under 40000 miles.'

matches.value: Cars selected on 2020-05-01: Black, under 40000 miles.

query_sentence: Extract car inventory, find all black cars with less than 40000 miles, and save them to a new Excel file.

New Excel file should be named black_cars.xlsx and placed in the data folder.

Include at least Car ID, Miles, Color, and Driver columns in the Excel export.
